inconsistency_note: Text on page 6 states that A. gambiae in deep forest displayed 'kdr-w frequency of 0.997 in A. gambiae 6 years later in 2012 (of 384 mosquitoes, only one was heterozygous)', but Fig. 4 gives n=184 for Deep Forest A. gambiae. With 183 RR and 1 RS out of 184, the resistant allele frequency is (183*2 + 1)/(184*2) = 367/368 = 0.99728, exactly matching the printed 0.997, indicating 384 in the text was a typographical error for 184.
